scripts.test: npm run test:sh && npm run test:ps
scripts.test:sh: shellcheck src/backdrop.sh src/install.sh test/backdrop.bats && bats test/
scripts.test:ps: pwsh -Command "\$result = Invoke-Pester test/backdrop.tests.ps1 -Output Detailed -PassThru; if (\$result.FailedCount -gt 0) { exit 1 }"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:sh && npm run lint:ps
scripts.lint:ps: pwsh -Command "\$exclude = @('PSAvoidUsingWriteHost', 'PSUseShouldProcessForStateChangingFunctions'); \$results = 'src/backdrop.psm1', 'src/install.ps1' | ForEach-Object { Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path \$_ -Severity @('Error', 'Warning') -ExcludeRule \$exclude }; if (\$results) { \$results | Format-Table RuleName, Severity, Line, Message -AutoSize; exit 1 }"
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:sh:fix && npm run lint:ps:fix
scripts.install:ps: pwsh -Command "Install-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -Scope CurrentUser -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Install-Module -Name Pester -Scope CurrentUser -Force -MinimumVersion 5.0 -ErrorAction Stop"

plugins.prepareCmd: sed -i 's/^VERSION=.*/VERSION="${nextRelease.version}"/' src/backdrop.sh && sed -i 's/^\$script:Version[[:space:]]*=.*/\$script:Version          = '"'"'${nextRelease.version}'"'"'/' src/backdrop.psm1 && sed -i 's/ModuleVersion[[:space:]]*=.*/ModuleVersion     = '"'"'${nextRelease.version}'"'"'/' src/backdrop.psd1

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run lint && npm run test
